narrative.overview: A working record kept by an operator: warm paper, black ink, hard 1px rules and one gold accent. Type does the work, real photography carries the emotion and real figures carry the proof.

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold underlines at most three headline phrases per page.

rules.name: The Readable Gold Rule
rules.body: Small gold text on light surfaces uses Gold Ink #8A6510.

rules.name: The Twelve Pixel Floor
rules.body: No text a visitor needs to read or tap sits below 12px.

rules.name: The Rule Line Rule
rules.body: Separate with a 1px line, not a card or a shadow.

dos: Do use only photography and video from AToure's own projects.
Do keep every corner square and every divider a 1px rule.
Do keep video light: 720p, a poster, load on arrival.
donts: Don't add shadows, glows, gradient text or rounded corners.
Don't bring back Cormorant Garamond or Jost on the website.
Don't use Field Gold for small text on light backgrounds.
Don't use AI generated images to stand in for real events.
